name: Infantry
comment: Types of Infantry that can be found in the game - e.g. Minigunner, Engineer etc.

properties.name: IsFemale
properties.comment: If this civilian infantry type is female, then this flag will be true. This information is used to get the correct voice response.

properties.name: IsCrawling
properties.comment: Does this infantry unit have crawling animation? If not, then this means that the 'crawling' frames are actually running animation frames.

properties.name: IsCapture
properties.comment: For those infantry types that can capture buildings, this flag will be set to true.

properties.name: IsFraidyCat
properties.comment: For infantry types that will run away from any damage causing events, this flag will be true. Typically, this is so for all civilians as well as the flame thrower guys.

properties.name: IsCivilian
properties.comment: This flags whether this infantry is actually a civilian. A civilian uses different voice responses, has less ammunition, and runs from danger more often.

properties.name: IsAvoidingTiberium
properties.comment: For 'fraidycat' infantry types that will run away from any damage causing events, this controls whether they avoid wandering into Tiberium.

properties.name: Type
properties.valid_values: NONE, E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, RAMBO, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10, MOEBIUS, DELPHI, CHAN
properties.comment: This value represents the infantry class. It can serve as unique identification for this infantry class.
